text: Meet Hotel P M S. The simple way to run your hotel, and delight every guest.
Start each day with a clear picture: occupancy, arrivals, departures, and everything waiting for a reply.
See every room on one calendar. Pick the dates, and only the rooms that are truly free appear, priced in pesos.
Your guests get their own app, right on their phone. They sign up in a moment.
They pick their dates, see what's available, and reserve. Every request waits for your approval.
They can order extras, like airport pickup or breakfast, and ask you anything.
You confirm the booking, reply, and approve the service. The guest sees it instantly, and extras join their bill.
Hotel P M S. One system for your hotel. One app for your guests.
